messages:
maria: Heads-up — did a quick pass on the API keys delete flow. Main concern: 'soft delete' vs 'permanent delete' copy and the undo timing. If we show undo toast for 5s it's too easy to miss; but if we show it too long it can cause lingering clutter. Thoughts? :thinking:
aj: Agree. Current mock shows 5s. UX research suggests 8–10s for destructive actions. Can we do 10s with an accessible `aria-live` alert and a keyboard-focusable 'Undo' button?
sam: FWIW we need to check perms: users without delete/restore perms shouldn't see an undo toast that implies they can restore. Might be confusing if the toast has 'Restore' but the action fails. Maybe only show toast if delete succeeded and user has restore perms.
leah: Also the modal copy 'This will permanently delete the key' is triggering. We only soft-delete. Change to: 'Remove access (can be restored for 30 days)'. Keep 'permanently' only for the final expiry screen.
maria: +1. Also color: current red banner (danger) feels too heavy for soft-delete and may fail contrast. Consider using a neutral-warning token instead of full danger for soft-delete.
aj: Implementation note: backend currently marks keys with `deleted_at`. We can set `retention_days` to 30. Frontend should show a small 'Expires in X days' pill next to the key in the list and in the details flyout.
leah: Accessibility nits: focus should remain in the modal after confirm, not jump back to the list where keyboard focus lands unpredictably. Also the undo toast should have role="alert" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce it.
sam: Copy suggestion for modal body: 'This removes the key from active use. You can restore it within 30 days. After that it will be permanently deleted.' Primary CTA: 'Remove key' (destructive). Secondary CTA: 'Cancel'.
maria: UX question: should rotation be offered in the same modal? e.g., 'Remove and rotate' checkbox? Could be confusing. Maybe a follow-up CTA: 'Rotate existing keys' shown after removal? :shrug:
aj: I'd avoid mixing flows. Keep removal focused. Add a small inline link 'Want to rotate instead?' that opens the rotate modal.
leah: Keyboard shortcuts: support Enter to confirm, Escape to cancel. Add visually hidden text describing 'This action can be undone for 30 days' so it's read by screen readers when the modal opens.
designbot: Note: PR #412 contains draft wording and UI mocks. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/412 :white_check_mark:
maria: Okay — agreed action items: 1) Update modal copy per sam; 2) Increase toast timeout to 10s and add aria-live per aj; 3) Adjust banner color & run contrast checks per leah + design; 4) Ensure restore-permissions check before showing undo per sam; 5) Add 'Expires in X days' UI token per aj. I'll file a tiny spec and ping eng for a focused PR. Thanks everyone :rocket:
